subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Query Parameters and Filtering
description: A short lesson to help you apply Query Parameters and Filtering.

hook.text: An endpoint returns 50,000 records with no filtering. The client crashes trying to render them all.

buildup.text: Query parameters let clients filter, sort, paginate, and search without needing separate endpoints.

discovery.text: Testing covers valid filters, invalid values, missing parameters, and combinations that conflict.

twist.text: Untested edge cases in filtering—like negative page numbers or SQL in sort fields—become attack vectors.

climax.text: A test suite for query parameters catches an injection vulnerability in the sort parameter.

punchline.text: Every parameter is an input. Every input needs testing.

quiz.question: Why must query parameters be tested for edge cases?
options: Invalid values can cause crashes or security vulnerabilities
